name: 75. Anthropic attachments: base64 PDF + Files API file_id across endpoint shapes (cowork-attachments)
description: Cowork and API clients attach local files either inline (data URL / base64 document) or by Files API file_id. 75.01-75.04 pin base64 application/pdf through native /anthropic/v1/messages (non-stream + stream), /v1/chat/completions file.file_data and /v1/responses input_file.file_data (core/providers/anthropic/utils.go ConvertToAnthropicDocumentBlock / ConvertResponsesFileBlockToAnthropic data-URL branch). 75.05-75.09 upload fixtures/arxiv-1706.03762.pdf from disk and pin document.source.type=file, OpenAI-shape file.file_id and Responses input_file.file_id, then delete. Every inference row sends x-bf-send-back-raw-request/-response and asserts the document block that actually reached Anthropic (source type, media_type, bare base64 / file_id) plus the raw Anthropic message carrying the marker; the runner enables client_config.allow_per_request_raw_override first (set-raw-override-config.mjs). Unlike the [PREVIEW] file_id rows in folder 12 these run by default: the Files API is GA and needs no beta header (platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/files). Inline fixture: fixtures/cowork-marker-inline.pdf (marker indigo-418). Upload fixture: arXiv 1706.03762 (marker is the arXiv id).

exec: pm.test('75.01: 2xx', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + pm.response.text()).to.be.below(400); });
if (pm.response.code >= 400) { return; }
pm.test('75.01: marker indigo-418 found in reply', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('indigo-418'); });
var body = pm.response.json() || {};
var ef = body.extra_fields || {};
var rr = ef.raw_request; if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('75.01: raw_request captured', function () { pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing - is client_config.allow_per_request_raw_override on?').to.be.an('object'); });
if (!rr || typeof rr !== 'object') { return; }
var doc = null; (rr.messages || []).forEach(function (m) { (Array.isArray(m.content) ? m.content : []).forEach(function (b) { if (b && b.type === 'document') { doc = b; } }); });
pm.test('75.01: document block reached the wire', function () { pm.expect(doc, 'wire messages: ' + JSON.stringify(rr.messages || rr).slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('object'); });
if (!doc) { return; }
var src = doc.source || {};

pm.test('75.01: wire source is base64 application/pdf', function () { pm.expect(src.type, 'source: ' + JSON.stringify(src).slice(0, 200)).to.eql('base64'); pm.expect(src.media_type, 'source: ' + JSON.stringify(src).slice(0, 200)).to.eql('application/pdf'); });
pm.test('75.01: wire data is bare base64 PDF bytes (no data: prefix)', function () { var d = String(src.data || ''); pm.expect(d.indexOf('JVBERi0'), 'data head: ' + d.slice(0, 40)).to.eql(0); });
var rs = ef.raw_response; if (typeof rs === 'string') { try { rs = JSON.parse(rs); } catch (e) { rs = null; } }
pm.test('75.01: raw_response captured', function () { pm.expect(rs, 'raw_response missing').to.be.an('object'); });

if (rs && typeof rs === 'object') { pm.test('75.01: raw_response is an Anthropic message carrying the marker', function () { pm.expect(rs.type, 'raw_response: ' + JSON.stringify(rs).slice(0, 200)).to.eql('message'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(rs.content || []), 'raw_response content').to.include('indigo-418'); }); }
